joy: Heads-up: CI perf alert on PR #6430 — microbench kernel-selector p50 up ~12% vs baseline. perf-bot output below.

perf-bot: CI PERF CHECK FAILED for pr/6430
diff:
- p50: 18.2ms
+ p50: 20.4ms (+12.1%) (threshold 5%)
snippet:
```
BenchmarkKernelSelect/short_sequence
baseline: 18.2ms
current: 20.4ms
warmup_iters: 8 -> 12
```

matt: cc @joy @olga ok i'll bisect locally. any recent warmup changes?

olga: I changed warmup heuristic in commit abcdef1 (PR 6401) to increase warmup for low-latency sequences to avoid cold starts. Could be related.

ryan: I ran the microbench locally with same seed, saw ~+11% p50. KV hitrate unchanged.

matt: bisect indicates commit abcdef1 is the regression. The change bumped warmup_iters from 4 to 8 for short sequences when batch size=1. Reverting that locally restores baseline.

joy: Huh. Why did we increase warmup? Wasn’t it to stabilize cold-start variance on dedicated pools?

olga: Yes — we saw high variance on long-running workloads. But that heuristic probably misfires for microbench short seqs.

matt: Minimal fix: add sequence-length threshold so we don't inflate warmup for seq <= 32. Proposed snippet:
```
- if (est_seq_len < 64) warmup_iters = 8;
+ if (est_seq_len < 32) warmup_iters = 4;
```

olga: OK here's quick patch to try; pushing in a branch now. Running local microbench.

perf-bot: @matt run-perfcheck --pr 6430 --bench KernelSelect/short_sequence --retries 5

matt: Local results after patch: p50 18.5ms (+1.6%), within noise. Rerunning CI.

joy: If CI still flakes we should revert PR 6401 from main and open follow-up to make heuristics adaptive. Rollout blocker? I'd prefer revert if CI doesn't pass.

ryan: Also suggest increasing perf CI threshold for microbench to 7% for short seqs to avoid noisy failures until we root cause. Not ideal but reduces false positives.

olga: Agree on follow-up. I'll open a PR with fix and tests that assert warmup only increases for seq >= 64. Also add a perf regression test that runs with a fixed seed.

matt: CI rerun queued: https://ci.internal/redwood/pr/6430/1234

perf-bot: CI rerun started, will post summary.

joy: Thanks everyone. Action items: olga -> fix-heuristic PR; matt -> monitor CI rerun; ryan -> proposal for threshold change in perf-ci config. We'll reconvene if rerun fails. :thumbsup:
